note: Range-and-habitat surfaces, certified by scripts/build-range-habitat-surfaces.mjs. Separate from the other registries so no builder can erase another's surfaces.

history.detail: First publication: range from clustered record squares, categorical habitat inside it.

Ground inside the range rated unsuitable kept as its own state; water, sea, ice and town masked for profiles that do not name them; values placed on the grid nodes the renderer samples (1.0.0 sat half a cell south-west); an island rule for sedentary families; elevation and coast requirements; confidence from components rather than record counts alone.

confidence.rule: Never HIGH: a habitat profile measures no animals. MODERATE when every component holds, LIMITED otherwise. range evidence: fails (570 records in 22 squares (needs 300 in 30)); habitat concordance: holds (record squares on moderate-or-better land 34 in 100 against 31 in 100 across the range (ratio 1.11; needs 1)); seasonal applicability: holds (all-year records for a species that stays); source age: holds (records read 2026-09-30; land cover epoch 2019 (its age is reported with the surface)); resolution: holds (habitat at 0.1° (about 11 km); range edge from records within 25 km).
